summary: Stand up a productized AI services firm for one high-ticket local niche: research niche, build one-problem asset pack, run gated local ads, land 2–3 design partners, film case study, then productize workflows. Brandon approves spend, outreach identity, and any hire/pay.

steps.title: Pick niche + geo
steps.detail: Score niches with the published opportunity rubric; shortlist 3; Brandon picks one.

steps.title: One-problem asset pack
steps.detail: Draft offer, math/receipts one-pager, landing page copy, application form. No publish until gate.

steps.title: Brandon publish + ads gate
steps.detail: Approve domain, ads spend, and outbound identity before anything goes live.

steps.title: Hyper-local Meta campaign
steps.detail: Launch application-flow ads in one geo; log leads for Brandon review before replies.

steps.title: Design partners + case study
steps.detail: Deliver for 2–3 clients; film/write case study. Hire/contractors need Brandon pay/hire gate.

steps.title: Productize workflows
steps.detail: Turn SOPs into agent-run checklists; repeat in next geo only after Brandon yes.

disclaimer: Not financial advice. No income guarantees. Past creator anecdotes do not predict results. Brandon must approve money, hire, pay, publish, and send.
